name: Oomenomonryuuin Sumika
original_name: 大女ノ門龍院 澄香
source:
Hakari right hand and only other student council member. Is very kind and friendly to everyone but is also naive. Due to her pureness is easily able make friends and often able to calm people just by being around them. Despite her gentle demeanor has unreal strength that is second only to Neko. Not a very good athlete all around though it is mention she is fast learner and even hinted that her large chest is main reason she isn't a better athlete. 

Likes: When her classmates get along
Dislikes: People who fight
Hobbies: Making friends
